description: This file defines a custom layout manager 'VerticalFlowLayout' in Java, which arranges components vertically with configurable alignment and gaps. It includes properties for alignment, gaps, and methods for layout calculations, as well as constants for various alignment options. The class likely used within a GUI application to manage component placement.

classes.name: VerticalFlowLayout
classes.description: A custom layout manager for arranging components vertically with various alignment options, supporting serialization and flexible spacing.

methods.name: setMaximizeOtherDimension
methods.description: Sets whether to maximize the dimension orthogonal to the flow direction for all components.

methods.name: isMaximizeOtherDimension
methods.description: Returns whether components are being maximized in the dimension orthogonal to the flow.

methods.name: getAlignment
methods.description: Retrieves the current alignment setting for component rows.

methods.name: setAlignment
methods.description: Sets the alignment for component rows, choosing from predefined constants.

methods.name: getHgap
methods.description: Returns the horizontal gap between components.

methods.name: setHgap
methods.description: Sets the horizontal gap between components.

methods.name: getVgap
methods.description: Returns the vertical gap between components.

methods.name: setVgap
methods.description: Sets the vertical gap between components.

methods.name: addLayoutComponent
methods.description: Unused method for adding layout components, present for compatibility.

methods.name: removeLayoutComponent
methods.description: Unused method for removing layout components, present for compatibility.

methods.name: preferredLayoutSize
methods.description: Calculates the preferred size of the container based on visible components.

methods.name: minimumLayoutSize
methods.description: Calculates the minimum size needed for the container.

methods.name: moveComponents
methods.description: Helper method to position components within a row according to alignment.

methods.name: layoutContainer
methods.description: Lays out the components within the target container according to the layout rules.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the layout manager's configuration.
